title: A variable can use the variables defined before it
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR a = [Order Count] VAR b = a * 2 VAR c = b + a RETURN c )

source.quote: the definition of a variable can reference other variables provided that the other variables have been defined beforehand
source.supports: later variables can use earlier ones

source.quote: Variables can refer to previously defined variables.
source.supports: later variables can use earlier ones

derivation: [Order Count] is COUNTROWS ( Sales ) = 7. b = 7 * 2 = 14, c = 14 + 7 = 21. COUNTROWS is an integer and integer arithmetic stays integer.
